mechanism: Foscarnet causes electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) that increase risk of statin-induced myopathy and rhabdomyolysis, compounded by simvastatin's CYP3A4 metabolism and renal clearance issues.
action: Monitor electrolytes closely, consider alternative statin (pravastatin) with lower myopathy risk, or temporarily discontinue simvastatin during foscarnet therapy; monitor CK and renal function.
